summary: Iteration 4 testing of iteration_3 fixes (bank name-check SIMULASI mismatch + NIB QR domain hardening) and NEW Didit unconfigured integration. Created /app/backend/tests/test_didit_and_regressions.py with 15 tests — all 15 pass. Frontend Playwright: owner logged in, opened application detail, verified didit-card + validation-card + score gauge + AI review render; clicking didit-create-button correctly shows toast 'Didit belum dikonfigurasi (API key kosong)'. FIXED a critical frontend bug: ApplicationDetail.js referenced diditState/createDidit/refreshDidit but they were never declared — component would throw ReferenceError at runtime. Added useState + handlers.

ui_bugs.issue: diditState, createDidit, refreshDidit were referenced in JSX but never declared — page would crash on render. FIXED by testing agent (added useState + createDidit/refreshDidit handlers wired to /api/applications/{id}/didit/session and /decision, plus loading a.didit into diditState on load).

action_items: Review the frontend fix applied to /app/frontend/src/pages/ApplicationDetail.js (added diditState state + createDidit + refreshDidit). It calls POST /api/applications/{id}/didit/session and GET /api/applications/{id}/didit/decision, mirrors the backend contract (configured:false → toast 'Didit belum dikonfigurasi (API key kosong)'; session_id → shows refresh button + status; error → error toast). No further action required if fix is acceptable.
critical_code_review_comments: verify_bank() SIMULASI branch now correctly compares resolved(=holder) vs {legal, brand} only — mismatch test passes (score 0, verified=false, status=mismatch).
decode_nib_qr uses urlparse(data).hostname with exact 'oss.go.id' or endswith '.oss.go.id' — the lookalike 'oss.go.id.malicious.example' now correctly gets domain_valid=false. Good hardening.

didit_create_session()/didit_get_decision() correctly gate on env vars (DIDIT_API_KEY + DIDIT_WORKFLOW_ID) and return {configured:false} when empty. RBAC applied on both endpoints. GET /decision correctly 400s when no session exists.

ApplicationDetail.js had undeclared references (diditState/createDidit/refreshDidit) — this passed webpack because ESLint react-hooks/no-undef isn't enabled here; it would crash at first render. Fixed by testing agent. Main agent should adopt this pattern or refactor.
nib_registry_lookup SIMULASI always returns AKTIF and validate_nib still doesn't consult registry.status — same code review comment as iter3, unchanged.
verify_bank threshold sim >= 0.5 with token-set similarity — for real BRIAPI resolved names this may be too lenient/harsh. Consider Levenshtein/fuzzy ratio when BRI live.

rca of the issue: Frontend crash bug RCA: The Didit KYC/KYB card was added to ApplicationDetail.js JSX with references to `diditState`, `createDidit`, and `refreshDidit`, but the corresponding useState hook and handler functions were never added to the component body — likely lost during the iter3 file truncation-and-rebuild (main agent noted the file was 'corrupted twice then fixed by truncating to valid 270 lines'). Webpack ESLint config doesn't fail on undeclared JSX identifiers (only react-hooks/exhaustive-deps warned). At runtime, first render of any application detail page would throw ReferenceError: diditState is not defined. Reproduction: login as owner, click any row in dashboard → white/blank page with console error. Mitigation applied: added `const [diditState, setDiditState] = useState(null);` and `createDidit`/`refreshDidit` async functions that call POST /didit/session and GET /didit/decision with proper toast handling for configured:false, session_id, and error paths. Load() now hydrates diditState from a.didit.
